supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends laterally beyond the vertical plane of the outer eye corners.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Low to moderate contrast; the muzzle region shows slightly higher pixel intensity (lighter) compared to the dark, mottled periocular and cheek areas.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Lower lip shows moderate vertical thickness in a neutral, non-drooping state.

other_distinctive_markers: Heavy light-colored mottling/speckling across the dark facial skin, particularly dense on the cheeks and muzzle.
